transcript.description: What the user said, as text from speech recognition.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag of the recogniser locale, e.g. en-IN. Optional.

surface.description: Device surface: screenless, screen, or tv.

household_id.description: Opaque id; enables opt-in alias memory.

candidate_ids.description: Candidate ids from music_resolve_request to build hooks for.

max_seconds.description: Maximum clip length in seconds (≤ 4). Default 3.

window.description: Window inside the 30 s preview that was extracted (§6.4).

method.description: Hook heuristic id, e.g. energy-flux-v1 (§6.4). Honest heuristic: a loud, dense section, not guaranteed to be the chorus.

confidence.description: Heuristic confidence; published hit rate lives in the eval report (§6.4).

resolution_id.description: resolution_id from the music_resolve_request that was answered.

chosen_candidate_id.description: The candidate the user chose (or that was finally played).

remember_alias.description: Save 'when I say X I mean Y' for this household. Default false; only set true when the user explicitly consented (§6.3).

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; retrying with the same key returns the same receipt (§8.6).

receipt_id.description: Action receipt id; answerable via music_explain_last_action (§6.7).

household_id.description: Opaque household id; pass at least one identifier (household or session).

session_id.description: MCP session id; pass at least one identifier (household or session).

trigger.description: What triggered the action: voice vs routine vs external (§6.7).

at.description: When the action happened, ISO-8601 UTC (§6.7 stores the time).

reason.description: Why the style changed, e.g. barge_in (user interrupted), short_answer, routine.

applies_until.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant until which the style applies. CONTRACT DRAFT: blueprint §5.2 gives no type or expiry semantics — assumes the session-store TTL; AMBIGUITY flagged to ORCH (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

household_id.description: Opaque household id; enables history-aware selection (§6.6).

emergency.description: Number of 'emergency vibe' tracks to cache. Default 5.

next_up.description: How many queued tracks to cache next. Default 3.

mood_hint.description: Optional free-text mood hint for selection.

byte_budget.description: Hard byte budget for the cache plan. Required: blueprint §5.2 names it as key input but ships no default, so the caller must state it.

task_id.description: Task handle for the cache-preparation task [VERIFY R-SPEC-05].

status.description: Task status token [VERIFY R-SPEC-05: exact vocabulary comes from the spec task states — deliberately not enumerated here to avoid inventing codes.]

provider.description: Music provider identifier to link [VERIFY R-MUSIC-01: blueprint §5.2 names only 'provider' — the identifier vocabulary depends on which providers R-MUSIC clears (terms, previews, OAuth); do not enumerate until then.]

status.description: Link status. CONTRACT DRAFT vocabulary (blueprint §5.2 says 'link status' only): linked/already_linked on success; pending while URL-mode elicitation is outstanding. Final handshake lands with notifications/elicitation/complete [VERIFY R-SPEC-04].

household_id.description: Opaque household id whose aliases and receipts are deleted.

event_id.description: Monotonic id per trace connection; the console dedupes and orders on it (the lab's own id, distinct from the MCP SSE event id).

trace_id.description: One trace id per user turn, propagated host → MCP → upstream (§8.7).

span_id.description: OpenTelemetry span id when emitted from a span (§4.1).

source.description: Emitting process; alexa-lab relays server-side spans it receives (§4.1, §8.7 propagation).

badge.description: Truthful mode label for the turn: LIVE | REPLAY | FIXTURE (§4.2, AC-14).

sse_event_id.description: SSE event id from the server stream; reconnects resume with Last-Event-ID [VERIFY R-SPEC-01].

frame.description: Raw JSON-RPC frame for the inspector drill-down (§11.2). The emitter is responsible for redacting secrets; heard text appears deliberately — the inspector is the product's transparency surface.
